name: lint-fix
body: Run eslint --fix on the current project, then report remaining issues.

name: gen-types
body: Generate TypeScript type definitions from the project's API schema or database schema.

name: deploy-preview
body: Build the project and deploy to a preview URL for testing.

name: audit-deps
body: Run npm audit and report critical/high severity vulnerabilities with suggested fixes.

name: gen-migration
body: Analyze schema changes and generate migration files for Prisma or Drizzle.

name: storybook-gen
body: Scan React components and generate corresponding Storybook stories with variants.

name: changelog
body: Parse conventional commits and generate a formatted CHANGELOG.md entry.

name: benchmark
body: Execute performance benchmarks and generate comparison reports.
